reviews.text: Always gives good advice

Still at the top: the best aquarium shop in Paris. Manu is a passionate expert with unparalleled advice, ably assisted by Morgane. The prices are very reasonable, the equipment is high quality, and the fish are magnificent.
A place where you can trust the employees who are very attentive and knowledgeable.
A wonderful welcome and a genuine love for animals in this cozy little shop ❤️

An excellent place for enthusiasts. The shop offers long opening hours and the team is always available, friendly, and very patient. Their advice is invaluable and, unlike some other shops, they never push unnecessary purchases. You can feel their genuine generosity and love for their craft. I highly recommend it!

For my son's birthday yesterday, we bought two goldfish. The gentleman who sold them was kind, patient, and very professional; he knows and loves his job.

I highly recommend him. He has fish, plants, rabbits, hamsters...
A cozy and cute shop.
See you soon.
The shop didn't have what I was looking for, but the gentleman very kindly told me where to find them.
The boss loves his job, he's very competent, helpful, and generous—a real pleasure! Thank you for everything.
The water in the hamster enclosures is dirty...the poor animals...

The seller was very nice, and so was his trainee.

He sells beautiful animals.
I bought a gorgeous Russian hamster.
Thank you for my canary 🙂 …

A fantastic pet shop, much better than Animalis and all those other places 💩.
If you're looking for an advisor, follow-up, someone who listens, don't hesitate to go there. A great person, so go for it! …

The Graineterie du Petit Zoo is a wonderful discovery: a charming, well-stocked shop with a wide selection of pet supplies. The advice is excellent, and the staff are passionate and genuinely friendly. You can tell they know their products and love what they do.
A neighborhood shop just the way we like them: practical, welcoming, and reliable. I highly recommend it!
Friendly and attentive staff, rather than salespeople at all costs. A wide variety of fish species available.
A truly friendly, competent, and attentive shopkeeper. We used to go there regularly until our two rabbits passed away. Maybe one day...

Great place, the manager is super friendly, every time I go there with my children I receive a warm and very professional welcome.

I highly recommend it.
Excellent pet shop; I buy plants for my aquarium and food for my pet there. The staff are very friendly and have been giving good advice for years.

Always so friendly and full of great advice. I highly recommend them!
Thanks again for everything.

An exceptional place!!!!!!!!!

The staff will always give you the best advice.

The shop may seem tiny compared to all the big stores that exist now, but in reality, you can find absolutely everything you need there at unbeatable prices—cheaper than online.

In short, go without hesitation!

A small but well-stocked shop with a very friendly welcome.
I was looking for bird seed balls to put on the patio.
The owner found the product I needed in his stock.
Thank you to him for his kindness! 🙏 A very useful and rare local shop.
Well done! 👏👏👏
The owner is very kind and gives good advice. Perfect service, I highly recommend it.

Incompetent seller. I went to buy fish for the first time and he sold me two goldfish in a 20L aquarium (the minimum is 100L for this species). As a result, both died after a few days. Avoid at all costs.
Jusy excellent.

I've been coming here regularly for cat food for months and I never thought to leave a review.
Excellent service, top-notch seller!!
This store also sells seeds and plants at very reasonable prices  the owner is kind and engaging in this small local store deserves our support. Here is our new olive tree

A lovely little pet shop, the owner is great and full of good advice on how to care for your furry or scaly (and even feathered) little companions. I always find something to keep my bunny entertained, and the treats he offers are really good quality (not like the ones you find in supermarkets or big pet stores!). At least one of them absolutely loves them!!
18 euros for one betta..
My favorite pet store in Paris, super friendly and efficient service.

My hamster had fleas, so the shopkeeper treated my pet very kindly.
It's a family-run business with very experienced staff.
I highly recommend this wonderful shop!
Lovely manager. Always available, always finds solutions.
Reef tanks have become so rare in Paris, so well done, keep it up!
We are very grateful for the excellent advice: The owner took plenty of time and patiently tried on various muzzles for our dog. Communication in English was completely seamless. Highly recommended.
Very good
Really very nice, just like the owners.
Great shop, excellent advice, quality aquarium fish

We went to buy a hamster for my son, and the gentleman was very helpful and attentive, answering all the children's questions. We even went back for a second one!
If you're looking for someone who listens and loves their work, you won't be disappointed.

A super friendly employee gave us excellent advice regarding a muzzle for our Labrador! In Paris, you get a fine immediately on public transport if your dog isn't wearing a muzzle and you don't have one with you.

My daughter bought a betta fish, along with the aquarium, filter, and plants. She's thrilled!
Thank you so much to the Little Zoo Seed Shop.

The Little Zoo's Seed Shop is always top-notch! A warm and welcoming family-run business. We always receive a friendly welcome and excellent advice for our pets. They offer quality equipment at a very good price.

Here's a photo of my nano aquarium. Everything I bought from the Little Zoo's Seed Shop. The beautiful plant on wood was made by Emmanuel, the shop owner.

I highly recommend this pet shop!
A very nice little neighborhood shop.
A very nice neighborhood pet shop with quality plants. I happily buy my bettas and guppies there.

I 200% recommend this pet shop for adopting your pet and/or buying your pet food and supplies.

We adopted a very well-balanced and adorable little hamster. The owner is passionate, very gentle and caring with all his animals, and knows them all perfectly. I highly recommend it! 💕

Are you looking for a passionate expert who knows their craft inside and out, and above all, who takes the time to share their knowledge without pressuring you? From aquarium design to welcoming your guests, Manu will give you the best advice. Plus, the after-sales service is top-notch.

In short, if you're looking for a great place in Paris, I highly recommend them.
Very kind and knowledgeable staff
Highly professional, knowledgeable about his subject and the field. Doesn't hesitate to refer you to colleagues or third-party websites if needed. I recommend him :D
Best pet shop in Paris🫶 …
Great advice, good spirit, a good team, always beautiful fish and shrimp
The manager was incredibly kind... In addition to his expertise, he took the time and found the right words to give you the best advice! Thank you again and see you soon :)

Excellent pet shop! The staff is both welcoming and very knowledgeable. They gave me excellent advice on choosing the right food and habitat for my new pet. The shop is clean, well-organized, and offers a wide range of quality products. Thank you for your kindness and professionalism! I highly recommend this pet shop to all animal lovers.
Thank you Graineterie for your advice. Thanks to you, our fighter jet, which was in very bad shape, is thriving again!
The owner gives excellent advice.

I was looking for a pet shop near my home in the 15th arrondissement that sold plants for my aquarium, which I'm preparing to welcome a betta splendens sometime in September/October. I'm delighted to have discovered this shop. The other customers' reviews are all excellent, and I understand why! What a pleasure to find a pet shop that truly cares about animal welfare. The staff are passionate and offer sound advice without trying to push you to buy, unlike other well-known pet store chains... I'm also reassured to read that I can have confidence in buying fish, whose health is checked and monitored. You can count on me to pop in this Saturday.

Fantastic experience! My initial phone contact was very welcoming and motivated me to visit the shop. I came to adopt a young Russian hamster, and I received excellent advice. The staff were very welcoming and professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to introduce each hamster to ensure a good rapport. They explained everything thoroughly and were very reassuring.

I bought all the necessary accessories, which were of very good quality and at great prices. Furthermore, the animals in the shop have spacious living areas and are very healthy and calm!
My little Russian hamster is adorable, very well-balanced and gentle. She hasn't bitten me once; you can tell they were hand-raised and accustomed to handling. I will definitely be back (rather than going to chain pet stores). Go without hesitation! Thank you again :)
The owner and his daughter were very kind. A pleasant place.

My husband bought some cardinal tetras, rummy-nose tetras, glassfish, and a small angelfish from you a few days ago. They've developed white spot disease, which has already killed all our previous fish of the same species that we've had for …
Owner and his super nice daughter, lots of accessories for rodents, aquarists. One of the few animal stores in the area.

A well-stocked, very clean shop, with no animal or disinfectant smells! You can buy rabbits, dwarf hamsters, guinea pigs... all from the same reputable French breeder who produces very healthy animals... already accustomed to humans, which …
A wide selection: rabbits, fish, shrimp, plants... Excellent advice from a true specialist. Thank you!
Friendly Customer Service..very kind and easy personnel..Good advice especially if you are a first timer..highly recommended..

Great.
Thank you.
